description: Elliott Wave Theory (EWT) motive and corrective cycles mathematically integrated with ICT institutional liquidity footprints.

topics.name: 5-Wave Motive Impulse Sequence & 3 Cardinal Axioms

deterministic_criteria.rule_1_w2_retracement: Wave 2 must never retrace more than 100% of Wave 1 (P2 > P0 for bullish; P2 < P0 for bearish)
deterministic_criteria.rule_2_w3_length: Wave 3 is never the shortest wave among Waves 1, 3, and 5 (length(W3) >= min(length(W1), length(W5)))
deterministic_criteria.rule_3_w4_overlap: Wave 4 never enters the price territory of Wave 1 (P4 > P1 for bullish; P4 < P1 for bearish)

rules: The 3 Cardinal Rules are absolute mathematical axioms. If any rule fails, the wave structure is disqualified.
Wave 3 is typically the longest and most aggressive institutional displacement wave and must never be the shortest.
Wave 4 consolidation must strictly respect and defend the high of Wave 1 in a bull trend.

topics.name: Corrective Cycles (Zigzag, Flat, & Expanded B-Wave Sweeps)

deterministic_criteria.zigzag_5_3_5: Sharp corrective decline where Wave B retraces 50-61.8% of Wave A
deterministic_criteria.flat_3_3_5: Sideways corrective range where Wave B tests Wave A origin
deterministic_criteria.expanded_flat: Wave B sweeps beyond Wave 5 high (BSL Turtle Soup) before Wave C aggressively liquidates below Wave A low

rules: Corrective structures rebalance fair value after motive expansions.
An Expanded Flat B-wave is an institutional liquidity hunt designed to trap retail breakout traders.

topics.name: Fibonacci Projection Multiples & Wave Relationships
rules: Wave 3 institutional expansions statistically reach at least 1.618x the length of Wave 1.
Wave 2 pullbacks terminate inside OTE (62%-79%) or at the 50% CE of the Wave 1 displacement FVG.

topics.name: ICT & Elliott Wave Fusion (Liquidity & Cycle Synthesis)

deterministic_criteria.wave_1_ict: Displacement momentum causing initial Market Structure Shift (MSS)
deterministic_criteria.wave_2_ict: Discount retest of Bullish FVG at 50% Consequent Encroachment (50% CE)
deterministic_criteria.wave_3_ict: Run on internal liquidity with multiple consecutive FVGs and order flow dominance
deterministic_criteria.wave_4_ict: Internal range retest defending former resistance as support
deterministic_criteria.wave_5_ict: Terminal exhaustion raid into major external BSL/SSL pool forming Turtle Soup
deterministic_criteria.wave_abc_ict: Smart Money Reversal (SMR) confirming major HTF Market Structure Shift

rules: Never buy the top of Wave 5; Wave 5 is an institutional distribution phase into retail buy stops.
The highest-probability ICT entries occur during Wave 2 (FVG 50% CE limit entry) targeting Wave 3 expansion.
